newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BARNETT FINED OVER COMMENTS ABOUT JONES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BARNETT FINED OVER COMMENTS ABOUT JONES.

text.p: Derbyshire and former England batsman Kim Barnett has been fined by the county for commenting about the resignation of Australian Dean Jones as club captain.

Barnett has been fined 500 pounds ($819) sterling, with a further 1,000 pounds suspended until December 31 this year pending no further breach of England Cricket Board and club rules, for "a blatant and deliberate disregard of club policy".

Derbyshire said in a statement on Wednesday: "Despite being told by the club chairman, and subsequently the cricket chairman, that he was not allowed to comment publicly on the Dean Jones resignation, Kim Barnett chose to go on Radio Derby and be interviewed."
Former test batsman Jones, who last season led Derbyshire to second place in the county championship, quit six days ago. He blamed a lack of support from senior players for the decision.
